testcase.name: Easing applies only to motions; batch timing and reveal use the layer's raw M2 progress
Point counts: pointCount is the sum of batch sizes and never exceeds scene.maxPointsPerFrame(), at every instant of the example scenes
Reveal PREFIX: k = n at progress >= 1, else min(n - 1, floor(progress n)); 0 at the start, n - 1 just before the end, n when held after; a 1-point shape appears only at progress 1
Exact single-point placement: with the identity anchor and no motion, every coordinate is returned exactly; with a translation-only anchor, exactly anchor + point (one rounding per coordinate)
Order: batches follow layer insertion order (layerIndex increasing), points follow shape order; overlapping layers with identical timing and geometry are all emitted
Immutability: batches and layers are unmodifiable; coordinates() is a copy; accessors outside [0, size) throw IndexOutOfBoundsException
Omission: hidden layers (BEFORE, AFTER with ACTIVE_ONLY), empty shapes and empty reveals produce no batch; an empty scene gives an empty ACTIVE frame
